episode.title: In 1816 It Snowed In June In New England

synopsis: A volcanic summer without sun caused fresh snow to fall across New England in June 1816.

title_card.title: In 1816 it snowed during June.
title_card.subtitle: New England froze in a summer without sun.

caption:
In 1816, snow fell across New England during the month of June.

The catastrophic volcanic eruption of Mount Tambora in 1815 blocked sunlight worldwide and disrupted global weather patterns. Historical records from 1816 describe severe summer frosts destroying crops across North America.

Visuals created with AI.

Could you survive a summer with freezing snow?
